description: Stable surrogate key for one row in the final analytical fact table. It follows the source infectious-disease CSV row order.
source: Generated by the SQL builder from source row order.
usage: Use only as a row identifier; do not aggregate it as a health measure.

description: Name of the source fact dataset. For this final table the value is always infectious_diseases.
usage: Useful when a future backend exposes several fact tables.

description: One-based row number from data/raw/infectious_diseases.csv.
source: Generated from source CSV row order.
usage: Traceability back to the raw source table.

description: Year when the infectious-disease case was reported.
usage: Filter or group by year. The loaded source spans 2018-2025.

description: Month when the infectious-disease case was reported, encoded as 1-12.
usage: Filter or group by month for seasonality-style questions.

description: Compact year-month key in YYYYMM form.
usage: Sort or filter month-level periods without building dates.

description: Temporal grain of the source fact row. The value is always month.
usage: Helps downstream code avoid treating the table as daily or patient-level data.

description: Official Czech regional code for the reporting region.
usage: Use for exact region filters such as CZ010 for Prague.

description: Official Czech region label.
usage: Display label for grouped regional answers.

description: Three-character diagnosis code reported in the infectious-disease table.
usage: Primary disease filter value. KG-RAG should expand disease-family concepts to this column before aggregation.

description: Czech diagnosis label as used in the infectious-disease table.
usage: Display label beside diagnosis_code in final answer tables.

description: Matching MKN-10-CZ code from the official code list.
usage: Trace the fact diagnosis to the official MKN-10-CZ code list.

description: MKN-10-CZ dotted code form, if different from the plain code.
usage: Useful when displaying official code-list values.

description: Official Czech MKN-10-CZ diagnosis label.
usage: Use for terminology checks against diagnosis_name_cs.

description: Official IRI for the MKN-10-CZ code.
usage: Semantic traceability link for KG/entity answers.

description: Derived MKN-10 block/range containing the diagnosis code, such as A00-A09.
source: Derived from configured MKN-10 block ranges because the source CSV has chapters but no explicit block column.
usage: Main KG-RAG expansion column for disease-family queries.

description: Czech label for the derived MKN-10 block.
usage: Display or filter disease-family scopes such as Střevní infekční nemoci.

description: Provenance note for the block assignment.
source: Generated constant for derived block assignments.
usage: Documents that MKN block is derived, not directly present in the source CSV.

description: MKN-10-CZ chapter code range, for example A00-B99.
usage: Higher-level grouping above block.

description: MKN-10-CZ chapter number, for example I.
usage: Display chapter identifiers.

description: Czech MKN-10-CZ chapter label.
usage: Display higher-level disease category context.

description: True when diagnosis_code matched the official MKN-10-CZ code list.
source: Derived from the join to mkn10_cz.
usage: Quality-control filter. It should be true for all current infectious-disease diagnosis values.

description: Official NZIS age-group code.
usage: Exact age-group filtering and grouping.

description: Czech age-group label used in the infectious-disease table.
usage: Display label for grouped age answers.

description: Lower bound of the age group, inclusive.
usage: Normalize informal age concepts such as children or seniors 65+.

description: Upper bound of the age group, inclusive. The open-ended 75+ group uses the source code-list upper bound.
usage: Normalize interval questions and sort age groups.

description: True when age_group_code matched the official NZIS age-group code list.
source: Derived from the join to age_groups.
usage: Quality-control filter.

description: Sex category from the source table. M = muž, Z = žena.
usage: Filter or group by sex when needed.

description: Czech display label for sex_code.
usage: Display label in final answers.

description: EWS value from the infectious-disease source table. It is retained as a source dimension/code, not interpreted clinically by this project.
usage: Use only if a future question explicitly needs this source field.

description: Reported case-count measure for the aggregate row.
usage: Main measure to sum in answer SQL. Do not describe it as unique patients or incidence.
